newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Investors in Brazil Cerj sale to be announced Fri.
newsitem.headline: Investors in Brazil Cerj sale to be announced Fri.

text.p: Rio de Janeiro state will be announcing on Friday the investors who have prequalified to participate in the privatization auction of state power firm Companhia de Electricidade do Estado do Rio de Janeiro (Cerj), officials said.

The state's 78 percent stake in Cerj, which supplies 25 percent of Rio de Janeiro state's electricity and serves around 1.2 million customers, is to be sold on the Rio de Janeiro stock exchange November 20 for a minimum price of 499 million reais ($484.5 million).
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
